text: BaFin applies substance over form, so transferable, tradable, or profit-oriented reward units risk classification as crypto-assets or financial instruments in Germany, potentially triggering licensing obligations such as crypto custody or proprietary trading.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Liquid Equity Rewards (2025). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=5454054
abstract: BaFin applies substance-over-form. This means that transferable, tradable, or profit-oriented reward units risk classification as crypto-assets/financial instruments, potentially implicating licensing (e.g., crypto custody, proprietary trading).

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: reward units that are transferable, tradable, or profit-oriented
